decisions.summary: D1 names the text the candidate pass walks - the question fragment AND its .notes.html, because that is what record-format is handed - and carries BOTH bases with the corrected catch on the assembled one.
decisions.why: Unchanged by this round's commit (6e13a0c3 touches only the registry-keys bullet). Confirmed at round 3 by re-measurement: the assembled basis gives 7 candidates, 2 of the eleven proposed and 0 of the 3 that varied; the fragment-plus-notes basis gives 34, 2 of the 3 varying and 6 of the 8 core. The basis serves FR-001 and SC-001 and narrows nothing - it is the text the check actually reads.

decisions.summary: D1 lists the registry keys as a fourth input to rare_words and states the match rule - whole token against SOURCES.html's own key ids, never a substring - and now states FR-004's second half with it: text inside a <code> span is not scanned at all, both clauses recorded as FLOORS that remove nothing measured.
decisions.why: The one bullet this round changed. Serves FR-004 of the accepted spec, which carries both clauses in the same requirement and the same 'removes nothing measured' framing; the plan now restates the requirement in full instead of half of it, which adds no decision of its own. Its figures reproduce on my own run of measure.py R2 at this HEAD: at the cutoff of 2 the list is 34 candidates, TAIL 2/3, core 6/8, and the two tail terms caught are ['nrcs', 'out-to-out'] - so nrcs is one of the three terms whose presence varied and one of the two this list catches, exactly as the corrected sentence says. The struck '9 of 12' count that the earlier sweeps missed here (spelled 'the nine terms') is gone, and a grep over the feature leaves that number alive only where it is explicitly labeled as history. Narrows nothing: dropping a <code> span narrows the GM's 'every word in the entry' no more than the rarity cutoff does, and request.md's own closing section records that the GM chose the PURPOSE and left the mechanism to the measurement.

decisions.summary: rare_words is pure over its four inputs so its test needs no filesystem; the caller reads them.
decisions.why: Serves FR-006 and the project's rule that a hard-to-test inner function is lifted and tested on plain inputs. Unchanged.

decisions.summary: The cutoff is 2, stated beside the code that applies it, justified on the honest count - 2 of the 3 terms that varied and 6 of the 8 core.
decisions.why: FR-002 states the cutoff and requires the measurement beside it. Re-run of measure.py R2 at this HEAD reproduces the whole curve: 21 / 34 / 41 / 53 / 75 / 101 candidates at cutoffs 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 20, with TAIL 1/3 at 1 and 2/3 from 2 onward and core 6/8 from 2 onward. The plateau argument holds and the number lives where it is applied.

decisions.summary: What the word-level filter cannot reach - two phrases and one record-common word - goes into record-format's contract, not only into the research record.
decisions.why: FR-008 asks for exactly this, and the contract is the only place that can carry it since a defined agent launches with omitClaudeMd. Unchanged this round; confirmed at round 3.

decisions.summary: The acceptance bar moves in research/CLAUDE.md; features 258 and 259 keep their specs, including 259's SC-002 recorded unmet; docs/efficiency-tooling.md's feature-255 row gains a pointer to the new bar.
decisions.why: FR-009 and FR-009a word for word, and confirmed in place at round 3: the row keeps its finding verbatim and says its criterion is no longer the bar, the two tier-downgrade statements are named as a different decision and left alone, and research/CLAUDE.md carries the new bar. Not editing 258 and 259's specs is within - those are history, and FR-009 says so. Unchanged this round.

decisions.summary: Complexity Tracking accepts a corpus walk per prepass invocation, rejects a shipped word list and a cached frequency file, and carries the re-measured figures.
decisions.why: FR-006 requires the corpus derived at run time, so the walk is the spec's choice rather than the plan's addition. Its denominator is re-runnable (measure.py R4) and reproduced on my round-3 run - 19 files / 321 sections / 5,584 candidates / 0 keys and 1,511 files / 3,766 sections / 32,836 candidates / 0 keys - with the two wall clocks inside shared-container drift and well under FR-010's 5 s bar. Unchanged this round.

decisions.summary: Constitution XII marked N/A and the performance bookends marked N/A - no generator changes, no research assertion moved.
decisions.why: Correct on both. The one cost this feature adds is the prepass's own wall time, which FR-010 bars and T02 and T11 bookend. Unchanged.

decisions.summary: Phase 0 takes a make done baseline; the single-artifact target is the ways 010 entry feature 259 measured three times.
decisions.why: Constitution XIII, and SC-001 and SC-002 are stated on that entry, so the plan measures what the spec was measured on. Unchanged.

decisions.summary: Phase 3 is 'T09-T12, T11a' and names the substitution put to the GM (T11a, FR-011 and SC-007) as a numbered step.
decisions.why: tasks.md's T11a carries the same words, so the plan's phase list and the task list agree; FR-011 exists so this cannot fall off the end of the chain. Unchanged.
